title: 液化CO₂配管過渡解析に向けた一次元有限体積HEMモデルの段階的検証
subtitle: 液相から二相への遷移、数値感度、単相臨界流出componentおよびFVM境界couplingへの展開
objectives: Organize the conservative FVM and real-fluid thermodynamic verification path from Stage 1 through U3 B1.
Separate software verification, numerical characterization, model characterization and physical validation.
Record Gate 9 CFL-sensitive crossing-depth evidence without approving a root cause.
Record independent B0 and B1 discharge-component benchmarks without representing them as a physical boundary.
Define the controlled next path to single-phase FVM face mapping and finite-pipe coupling.
central_thesis: A conservative one-dimensional finite-volume HEM path for pure CO2 was progressively verified through single-phase controls, liquid-to-open-two-phase crossing and fixed post-crossing diagnostics. Gate 9 characterized a comparatively stable first-candidate time and position but a CFL-sensitive, non-monotone crossing depth. U3 B0 and B1 independently verified subcooled-liquid and single-phase compressible critical-state component laws. These are verification-only component benchmarks, not a physical FVM discharge boundary, integrated blowdown model, physical validation or design-use approval.
authorized_claims: Gate 9 execution is complete for the fixed contract.
Crossing depth is CFL-sensitive and non-monotone in the fixed sequence.
The crossing-depth root cause remains unapproved.
U3 B0 accepted 10 fixed cases and 30 transfer comparisons.
U3 B1 accepted 17 fixed cases and 77 Reference-Adapter comparisons.
U3 B1 reproduced deterministic single-phase critical-state search for the locked GAS_CRITICAL family.
U3 B1 retained exact closed and zero-pressure-drop stream-transfer identities.
U3 B1 retained area and discharge-coefficient scaling and Cd-independent critical pressure.
U3 B1 recovered the accepted B0 liquid limit within predeclared tolerances.
B0 and B1 are verification-only component benchmarks.
prohibited_claims: The model has been physically validated for real CO2 pipelines.
The model is approved for engineering design use.
A mesh-independent or CFL-independent two-phase solution has been demonstrated.
The crossing-depth or phase-chatter root cause has been established.
B1 is an approved physical discharge boundary.
Static pressure force and FVM face mapping are approved.
Two-phase critical discharge accuracy is approved.
An integrated blowdown model is approved.

update_rules: Do not silently replace historical results; retain prior versions and explain changed interpretation.
Every quantitative result must have an evidence-matrix entry.
Every result figure must identify source run, artifact, source SHA, backend and version.
Conceptual figures must not be represented as solver results.
Abstract and conclusion must be audited against prohibited claims.
Physical validation, design use and production approval remain false unless an explicit later gate changes them.
